title: Vietnam is looking to restrict social media for kids; here are the growing number of other countries doing the same
summary: Australia was the first country to issue a ban in late 2025, aiming to reduce the pressures and risks that young users may face on social media, including cyberbullying, social media addiction, and exposure to predators.
llm_summary: Several countries are imposing restrictions on social media use for kids to mitigate potential risks such as cyberbullying, addiction, and exposure to predators. Australia was the first to issue a ban in late 2025, and Vietnam is now considering similar measures. These moves aim to protect young users from the negative consequences of social media usage.
